messages:
carmen: Heads-up 4: release pipeline blocked. Publish step aborted because regendiff showed only property ordering changes in generated SDK types.

ci-bot: CI: release/sdk-workspace #608 failed  regendiff detected: packages/sdk/src/gen/models.ts

carmen: regendiff snippet:
```
- export interface Team { id: string; description?: string }
+ export interface Team { description?: string; id: string }
```

own: this is the familiar nondeterministic ordering from typegen/codegen. It keeps tripping "ensure-clean-publish" which treats any regendiff as an immediate blocker.

frank: quick unblock options:
- revert the generated commit and run publish (fast but loses any legit generated changes), or
- add a small normalization step after regen that stable-sorts object keys in generated files, then re-run regen in CI.

own: I prefer normalization + pin codegen in the workspace so CI uses identical binaries. I'll prepare a tiny tools/normalize-gen.js and pin @redwood/codegen in package.json.

carmen: also, can we make release-stamp smarter? For diffs that match pure ordering-only patterns, maybe it shouldn't force a semver bump. But that needs product/design approval.

frank: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/608 - pins codegen to 3.4.3, adds tools/normalize-gen.js, and introduces a regen-idempotency CI job that runs regen twice.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #608.

own: small code review nit: move normalize script under scripts/ and call it from the regen task. Also please add an explain-note in the PR describing why the normalizer is necessary (link to internal ticket).

frank: updated PR. Added docs/regen-notes.md with explanation and linked INF-1580. CI green.

ci-bot: CI passed; merge completed.

release-coordinator: re-ran release pipeline, publish step retried. No regendiff now. SDK v2.9.1 published.

carmen: filing follow-ups: 1) RFC to add deterministic ordering in typegen pipeline (owner: eng-ml), 2) audit workspaces for codegen pins, 3) proposal for release-stamp to ignore ordering-only diffs (product sign-off needed).

own: will draft the RFC and open the audit ticket.

frank: closing - release unblocked.
